item.text: {"asks":[{"quote":"Do you want Strata to normalize these, for example always showing \"Explore: search for tests\" style labels, or should it show what the provider sent?","question":"Should Strata normalize subagent labels or display the labels supplied by each provider?"},{"quote":"Tell me which you'd rather see and I'll do that one.","question":"Should finished activity remain collapsed under the message or move into the Trace drawer?"},{"quote":"Is eight the right number, or would you rather it show everything and scroll?","question":"Should the activity strip show eight visible rows or show all rows with scrolling?"},{"quote":"Is that enough, or do you want the error inline?","question":"Should subagent errors remain only in the trace or also appear inline in the activity strip?"}]}
